actionAdapters.when: 读取真实Batch和注册Steps的脱敏参数Schema
已冻结具名Batch的创建、克隆、目标顺序与真实基础字段编辑时，只保存目标Settings
用户明确要求运行已保存Batch，实际Steps副作用与完整运行范围已获授权时；配置任务默认不运行

inputs.name: projectRoot
inputs.constraint: 从当前消费项目读取并冻结，不要求新手重复抄写可读取事实

inputs.name: pipifySettings
inputs.constraint: 读取Assets内现存真实Settings GUID、路径及窗口草稿；两个配置Action用settingsGuid，run-batch用pipifySettingsGuid

inputs.name: batchChangeSet
inputs.constraint: 明确create/clone/edit与目标名称；新项目先只读参考当前MainDemo相关Batch并按项目目标核对职责/顺序/参数及Batch内外前置，说明保留/调整/不采用依据，不照搬环境或授权；按实际Sample声明定位，来源缺失如实报告。完整steps列表按编辑前sourceIndex保留复制排序，名称和索引仅来自目标Settings内实际来源，跨Settings参考不假装clone；edits仅当前Schema真实基础字段和严格JSON token

inputs.name: runRequest
inputs.constraint: 默认只保存；运行另按真实Steps冻结副作用、平台、凭据、写集和产物证据，不因配置授权自动运行

inputs.name: optionalSpriteAtlasProduction
inputs.constraint: 仅显式图集分支：先比较Unity原生文件夹图集，普通一文件夹一图集优先原生；按目录需求本身不自动选择生成器。确有批量规则、排除、预演或受控流水线需求时，冻结已保存SpriteAtlasGenerationSettingsSO路径/GUID、Enabled/Format/现有SpritePackerMode、稳定Rules及来源/排除/已存在输出根/归属、预演或生产/恢复意图；说明生成器存具体Sprite列表，成员变化须重跑，无额外合批或实测性能承诺。复杂Rules用原生Inspector/实际Editor通道，不通过ParamsJson或任意C#配置；旧项目/Batch不自动创建或插Step。

allow: confirmed target PipifySettingsSO Batch name/description/ordered Steps and exact editable public parameter fields
explicitly requested saved Batch execution only within separately confirmed Step write sets

optional spriteatlas.generate/recover: only explicitly requested execution of saved Batch, declared owned atlas/meta/manifest output and its settings-GUID recovery transaction; settings source edited only through actual Unity Editor asset channel
deny: Framework/package sources and handwritten Unity YAML
read-only, hidden or unsupported Array/List/object/property fields
arbitrary ParamsJson, Type.Method or C# execution
automatic pipeline execution, external write, deployment, Git or UPM publication from configuration authorization
implicit sprite atlas generation, old Batch insertion, source sprite edits/deletion, automatic Sprite Packer switching, hand-edited ownership manifest or arbitrary recovery directory

requiredFor: Batch creation, cloning, renaming or saved changes
step removal or complete list replacement
explicitly requested Batch execution and its destructive/external/credential steps
confirmation.rule: 已有授权持续有效；展示具体Settings、目标Batch、完整Steps顺序、字段地址与风险，值尤其凭据不回显。确认绑定当前PlanId；输入、资产、Registry或构建环境漂移后重新Plan，重载只Verify不重放。

evidence: live Registry StepIds and exact parameter field Schema
confirmed target Settings GUID/path and full target Batch/Steps change set
configure-batch complete file/state verification and no-op preservation
credential redaction, untouched fields and draft protection
optional requested execution Job final state plus actual Step artifacts/evidence without treating saved configuration as runtime proof
temporary verification cleanup and retained formal Batch

new-project MainDemo reference source and relevant Batch/Step comparison; project-specific prerequisites, platform/coordinate, dependencies, package/version/cache/output/signing and external-effects differences; reference does not rebind workspace, modify Demo, execute Sample Batch, or authorize extra steps

完整Android/iOS/WebGL打包按PROJECT_STRUCTURE三平台构建与HybridCLR基线：Config/HostKey/NetCmd正式导出、link保留、GenerateAll、当前目标业务编译、AOT/Game DLL拷贝、Bundle、Player，Android另有EDM4U前置。按实际项目、平台和前置适配，平台只读字段不冒充切换；保存Batch不证明安装/启用/生成，不扩大运行或外部副作用授权。
可选图集：新Step真实Registry/Schema与可信基础DTO、PreviewOnly=true默认、显式生产前差异/源与输出归属；运行后实际图集GUID/成员/manifest及重复no-op，失败恢复保持原写集，未完成事务保留。先生成再Bundle仅由项目保存顺序决定，旧Batch不改，Bundle/子图Play/Player/设备与提效测量分别验收。
